## Fonts

- `firmware/assets/fonts/OpenSans-ExtraBold.ttf, OpenSans-SemiBold.ttf`: Open Sans, Copyright 2020 The Open Sans Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/opensans). SIL Open Font License 1.1, full text in firmware/assets/fonts/OFL.txt. The logo and big font bitmaps in firmware/src/assets.rs are rendered from these files.
- `firmware/assets/fonts/5x7.bdf`: X11 misc-fixed 5x7 (via https://github.com/embedded-graphics/embedded-graphics). Public domain ("Public domain font. Share and enjoy.", in the file's COPYRIGHT property). firmware/src/font.rs is generated from it.
